model_annotation: This donut chart visually represents the distribution of data across two nested categorical dimensions: “Ambiguity Std (Outer)” and “Max Ambiguity (Inner)”. The outer ring, segmented into four shades of blue, corresponds to standard deviation levels (Std: 0.0, 0.47, 0.82, 0.94), with respective proportions of 49.0%, 47.7%, 7.0%, and 5.0%. The inner ring, divided into three lighter blue shades, reflects maximum ambiguity levels (Max: 1, 2, 3), with proportions of 38.0%, 39.0%, and 14.2%. Each segment’s percentage is labeled directly on the chart, and a legend on the right clarifies the color coding for both outer and inner categories. The chart effectively overlays two classification schemes to show how ambiguity metrics are distributed across their respective ranges.
